name.description: Project name of the workshop, also its folder under apps/.
name.x-prompt: What is the name of the workshop?

base.description: URL path the workshop is served under, e.g. /spiele/. Defaults to /<name>/.

port.description: Dev server port. Defaults to the next free port after the existing workshops.

kind.description: Existing listing kind the stub uses until <name> is added to ListingKind and WORKSHOPS. Defaults to the first listing kind.
